name: Heap Sort
description: Sorts using a max-heap: first builds a max-heap, then repeatedly extracts the maximum and places it at the end.
aim: Sort array in-place using heap data structure: O(n) build-heap + n × O(log n) extract-max operations = O(n log n) total.
howItWorks: Build max-heap from array in O(n) time

time.bestCase: Always O(n log n) — no best case improvement

complexity.spaceDescription: In-place sorting — only O(log n) stack for recursion

realWorld: Systems requiring guaranteed O(n log n) with O(1) extra space
Priority queue drain (sort all elements by priority)
External sorting when merge sort space unavailable
whenToUse: Need guaranteed O(n log n) without extra memory
Priority-based processing needing final sorted order
alternatives: Quick Sort — better cache performance in practice
Merge Sort — stable, same complexity but O(n) space
Intro Sort — hybrid (Quick + Heap + Insertion) for production
